evidence.quote: The course of study is conducted in German.
Deadlines: 15 July for international applicants (only through uni-assist)

notes: The page says the programme is taught in German; English language skills: no minimum level required. Tuition is free (None) for all students, so it applies to non-EU applicants too. Application deadline 15 July is for international applicants but no year is given, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. The application channel is uni-assist (de-uni-assist), not the VPD route (de-uni-assist-vpd), because the page says "Please apply via uni-assist." and does not mention a preliminary review (VPD).

evidence.quote: German language skills C1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Goethe-Zertifikat: Goethe-Zertifikat C1 ÖSD Zertifikat: C1

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre diplôme marocain est reconnu comme équivalent à l'Abitur ou à la Fachhochschulreife via anabin; sinon, le Freshman Year peut être une voie.
note.en: Check whether your Moroccan diploma is recognised as equivalent to the Abitur or Fachhochschulreife via anabin; otherwise the Freshman Year may be a route.

evidence.quote: German entrance qualification for universities of applied sciences or equivalent (http://anabin.kmk.org) Many international students do not fulfil these requirements, but can qualify through the "Freshman Year" (https://www.fh-aachen.de/en/freshman).
